metrics.label: Facebook Evolution > Feed Posts Impressions
metrics.definition: Times feed posts were displayed. Does NOT include reels.

metrics.label: Facebook Evolution > Total Content Interactions (feed posts + reels)
metrics.definition: Interactions received by all Page content: feed posts + reels. Does not include stories.

metrics.label: Facebook Evolution > Reels Video Views
metrics.definition: Number of video views received on your reels.

metrics.label: Facebook Evolution > Total Content (feed posts + reels)
metrics.definition: Number of pieces of content published on the Page: feed posts + reels. Does not include stories.

metrics.label: Instagram Evolution > Views
metrics.definition: Total number of times the account's content was displayed, all formats (feed posts, reels, stories) plus profile. Organic and paid data.

metrics.label: Instagram Evolution > Total Content Interactions (feed posts + reels)
metrics.definition: Interactions (likes, comments, saves and shares) received by all feed content: feed posts + reels. Does not include stories.

metrics.label: Instagram Evolution > Total Content (feed posts + reels)
metrics.definition: Number of pieces of content published in the period, all feed formats: feed posts (photos and carousels) + reels. Does not include stories. Use this to answer 'how much content was published'.

metrics.label: Threads Evolution > Post Views
metrics.definition: Total number of times that the post is displayed.

metrics.label: Threads Evolution > Interactions
metrics.definition: Number of interactions: Likes, Replies, Reposts and Quotes

metrics.label: Threads Evolution > Posts
metrics.definition: Number of posts published in the period. On Threads every piece of content is a post: this is the total content count.

metrics.label: Pinterest Evolution > Outbound clicks in period
Pinterest Evolution > Pins
metrics.definition: Number of pins published in the period. This is the total content count of the account.

metrics.label: TikTok Evolution > Video views in period
metrics.definition: Number of video views in the period

metrics.label: TikTok Evolution > Interactions
metrics.definition: Number of interactions on videos: Likes, Comments and Shares.

metrics.label: TikTok Evolution > Videos
metrics.definition: Number of videos published in the period. On TikTok every piece of content is a video: this is the total content count.

metrics.label: Youtube Evolution > Video Views
metrics.definition: Number of times the videos were watched

metrics.label: Youtube Evolution > Visited Videos Likes
metrics.definition: Number of likes of the visited videos

metrics.label: Youtube Evolution > Visited Videos Comments
metrics.definition: Number of comments received by visited video

metrics.label: Youtube Evolution > Visited Videos Shares
metrics.definition: Number of shares of the visited videos

metrics.label: Youtube Evolution > Videos
metrics.definition: Number of videos published in the period (long videos and Shorts). This is the total content count of the channel.
